verdict.line: You lose if you walk an empowered auto into an up Riposte or brawl through her level 6-11 Blade Waltz window; you win if you bait W (Riposte) with Q or W first and all-in the moment it's down.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) parries the next basic attack, and Riven's entire damage pattern is built around Runic Blade-empowered autos, so Fiora's core defensive tool directly answers Riven's core damage tool. That's why this reads as even lane, 45.9% over 678 games, with solo-kill edge to Fiora and a defensive shape overall — Riven has to sequence around her cooldowns instead of just trading face to face.

theirWindow.what: Don't lead with a basic attack. Riposte only parries basic attacks, not spells, so an auto-first engage gets denied and your Runic Blade charge wasted while she reflects damage back.

yourWindow.when: she's just spent W or Q's double-dash
yourWindow.what: Riposte and Lunge's free second dash (Q, 16-8s CD, 600 range, usable twice within a couple seconds) are both down. All-in with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) stun and let your empowered autos land clean.

start.why: Highest-performing start at 46% over 752 games and 92.6% pick — the extra sustain and AD keep short trades even while you look for Riposte-down windows.

boots.why: 46.9% over 461 games, 60.7% pick — the ability haste shortens Q/W/E cooldowns, which is what lets you re-bait and re-engage before her Riposte comes back up.

core.why: Best-performing path at 63.7% over 91 games — the cooldown reduction feeds your Q/W/E loop, which is your entire answer to her parry.
Early damage and healing that keeps pace with her Duelist passive sustain during extended trades.
Damage mitigation over time smooths out her level 6-11 Blade Waltz burst window, which is her real kill threat per the data.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to burst through her before she can set up Riposte (58.6% over 58 games as an alt path)
her Duelist healing is stabilizing every trade and extending fights past your combo window
the game goes long and you need sustained DPS and armor shred in extended fights
her Burst of Speed auto-attack windows are doing more damage than her cooldown-based threats

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the repeated Q/W/E trades this lane forces you into, and the adaptive force stacking helps you out-sustain her Duelist healing over a long fight — the higher-performing page (52.7% over 10.9% pick) runs this.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 45.7% WR and 97.1% pick rate — Ignite cuts through her Duelist healing during your all-in window, which matters more here than in most matchups since she stacks sustain off every hit she lands.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before you auto
playing.detail: Open trades with Q (Broken Wings, 13s CD) or W (Ki Burst) rather than a basic attack. Riposte only parries basic attacks — once it's spent, your empowered Runic Blade autos land freely.

playing.title: Track her Q double-dash
playing.detail: Lunge (16-8s CD, 600 range) can fire twice within a couple seconds for free. If she's already used both charges, she has no gap-closer or escape until it resets.

playing.title: Avoid trading into her E buff
playing.detail: Burst of Speed (15-11s CD) spikes her attack speed and, once she lands a hit, her move speed too. Don't extend a trade while it's visibly active.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-11 kill window
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (130-110s CD, 400 range) is her stated solo-kill tool in this matchup. Don't push past the wave without a health buffer once she hits 6.

playing.title: Use E to block, not just to gap-close
playing.detail: Valor (10-6s CD) blocks incoming damage during the dash step — use it to eat her Q or a key auto, not only to reposition.

playing.title: Charge Runic Blade before entering range
playing.detail: Cast a spell before you're in auto range so your first hit is already empowered. Walking in auto-first is exactly what her Riposte punishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, summoners, and the win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG. The cooldown windows, Riposte-baiting sequence, and power-curve read are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
